output.summary: A perennial herb found across Europe, western Siberia, Asia Minor, the Caucasus and North Africa, dropwort favours dry, lime-rich pasture. It has fern-like leaves and clusters of creamy white flowers; mature crushed leaves smell of wintergreen. Its tuberous roots and young leaves can be eaten raw or cooked and taste bittersweet.
output.edibilityNote: Tuberous roots and young leaves can be eaten raw as salad or cooked as a vegetable; their taste is bittersweet.
